content: Real-time insights with zero lag. Get lightning-fast queries for in-game events, player analytics, and ad tech - where every millisecond matters.
Built for high-speed event ingestion process millions of in-game events per second with native support for streaming sources like Kafka, Kinesis and Pub/Sub.

High query concurrency, zero slowdown. ClickHouse powers real-time gaming leaderboards, player dashboards, in-game ads, betting interfaces, and live telemetry for both gameplay and wagering activities—handling massive user loads with instant responsiveness, unlike traditional data warehouses.
Native support for OpenTelemetry (OTel) - Capture logs, traces, and performance data in real time. Enable low-latency telemetry for monitoring player experience, game crashes and detecting anomalies.
Secure by design, built for compliance - Safeguard player data with CMEK, BYOC support, fine-grained access controls, and built-in GDPR-compliant TTLs and deletes.
